descByPlatform.chatgpt: Low-Angle Hero Product Photograph for CLAVIER 65 Mechanical Keyboard flagship launch. Subject: gunmetal 65% mechanical keyboard aluminum shell #3A3E44 with chamfered 45° edges, cream PBT keycaps #E9E2CC spherical sculpt, coral accent keycaps on ESC and enter #F27359, 'CLAVIER 65' 4pt sans-serif laser-etched rear badge, braided USB-C coil cable looping 180° camera-right in soft spiral. Setting: matte-black Full-Grain leather desk pad #111111 with visible pebble texture. Composition: Low-Angle Hero 18° below deck plane, Rule of Thirds ESC key at 33% x, Centered 50% y, Leading Lines keycap rows receding, keyboard 72% of frame. Camera: Phase One XF IQ4 150MP, Schneider 80mm LS at f/11, 1/160s, ISO 50, tripod, focus-stacked 6 frames. Lighting: Softbox Studio Rim Lighting + Side Lighting — 4×6ft softbox camera-right 50° elevation 1.5m (key), 1×4ft strip rim overhead-left 30° grazing top plate 1.2m (rim), 4×4ft white bounce camera-left 0.8m (cap fill), 4×4ft black flag behind camera to control bounce. Material physics: aluminum anodized micro-grain, PBT cap sugared matte, coral ABS smooth sheen, braided cable woven specular, leather pebble scatter. Color grade: Capture One Neutral-8 LUT grain 6 +0.1 EV. Palette: gunmetal 42%, cream PBT 30%, matte black 18%, coral accent 6%, cable highlight 4%. References: Ive Apple, Wired cover, Drop.com hero. Exclude: dust motes, flat lighting, plastic sheen, fingerprints, colour cast.
